scenes.headline: Other apps trust you. Drift checks.
scenes.voiceover: Every screen time app runs on the honor system. You know how that goes.

scenes.headline: Snap a photo. AI verifies it.
scenes.voiceover: In Drift, you snap a photo of the finished task. The AI actually checks it.

scenes.headline: Real proof. Real minutes.
scenes.voiceover: Proof accepted, minutes unlocked. No cheating, even on yourself.

scenes.headline: No photo, no feed.
scenes.voiceover: And until then, the feeds stay behind the shield.

scenes.headline: Earn your scroll. For real.
scenes.voiceover: Drift. Earn your scroll. For real this time.
